evals.name: branch-from-main-not-current
evals.prompt: start a new branch for fixing the login redirect bug. after login it sends people to /home instead of the page they came from
evals.expected_output: A fix/ branch of 3-5 lowercase hyphenated words, created from main's tip even though the session starts on an unmerged feature branch.
expectations: A new branch exists whose name starts with fix/
The part after fix/ is 3 to 5 lowercase words joined by hyphens
The new branch points at main's tip and does not contain the feat(export): add csv writer commit
HEAD is on the new branch at the end of the run
feat/csv-export still exists and still points at its original commit

evals.name: test-only-prefix
evals.prompt: I'm about to add the missing tests for the rate limiter, no changes to the limiter itself. make me a branch for it
evals.expected_output: A test/ branch (not feat/, chore/, or tests/) created from main.
expectations: A new branch exists whose name starts with test/, not feat/, chore/, or tests/
The part after test/ is 3 to 5 lowercase words joined by hyphens and mentions the rate limiter
The new branch was created from main and HEAD is on it at the end of the run

evals.name: rebase-onto-main
evals.prompt: main moved on since I branched feat/search-filters. bring my branch up to date with it
evals.expected_output: feat/search-filters rebased onto main (linear, no merge commit); any push of the rewritten branch uses --force-with-lease.

files.search/filters.py:
def by_price(results, max_price):
    return [r for r in results if r["price"] <= max_price]

files.search/query.py:
def build(term, limit=20):
    return {"q": term, "limit": limit}

expectations: feat/search-filters now contains the feat(search): add result limit commit from main
The price-filter commit sits on top of main's tip: the branch history is linear with no merge commit
main was not changed: it still points at feat(search): add result limit
If the transcript pushes the rewritten branch, it uses --force-with-lease and never a bare --force or -f
HEAD is on feat/search-filters at the end of the run
